study type: Laboratory study and pilot feasibility study
exposure: Self-collection and shipping of mid-turbinate nasal swabs
outcome: Feasibility of self-collection and shipping (collection and shipping rates)
Stability of influenza A and B virus RT-PCR cycle threshold (CT) values
Detection of human control gene (RNase P)
cohort: The pilot study involved 53 pregnant women with a medically attended acute respiratory illness.
finding: Self-collection of respiratory specimens by pregnant women is a promising research method, with CT values for influenza A and B viruses showing stability under specific storage conditions.
